prompt.text:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the ONLY edit target and boy identity. Image2 is approved same-direction anatomy/foot alignment only, NOT a timing or flight-phase command. Image3 is approved designs painting/material style only. Render ONE independent native high-resolution1254x1254 transparent RGBA full-canvas sprite. Latest motion requirement: one anatomical support foot stays planted continuously for frames01-08, then the other for09-16. Each successive contact position has TWO distinct poses: front landing, beneath body, first rear position, further rear contact until exchange. No both-feet flight. Fix real joints, do not duplicate a frame or translate/resize the whole picture. The stated support foot must show a broad, natural bearing sole or substantial planted forefoot, not a tiny tip, unsupported heel or underside aimed at viewer. Neutral ankle roll and foot yaw; knees/ankles/laces/heel-to-toe axis follow travel direction. Natural knee flex, no locked knee and no outward ankle kink.
Keep exact head/face/hair size and location, closed smile, torso/robe above knees, arms, RIGHT hand black/gold brush with ONE teal butt tassel, LEFT hand ivory scroll with black/gold rods and lower yin-yang tassel, and exactly TWO cyan ink spirits. Do not change prop connection or swap hands. Fully covered charcoal trousers, black/gold boots. Edit only requested lower limb articulation, preserving other swing leg unless necessary to avoid extra limbs. No ground plane, cast-shadow disc, contact line, text or watermark. Contact must read from pose and sole, not added marks. Keep all anatomy and accessories fully inside canvas.
Direct S toward camera. Anatomical RIGHT foot at imageLEFT is first-front-position SUPPORT. It is currently toe-up exposing broad dark underside. Locally lower its forefoot by ankle articulation onto the same plane as heel, so broad boot sole is planted and visible lower edge reads horizontal under load, with a small natural right knee bend. Keep toe/laces/ankle centered directly toward camera. Original right boot position aroundx550,y1180 remains the front contact location. Anatomical LEFT leg at imageRIGHT stays folded in swing behind. Preserve source distinct pose; no whole-body translation.
